learning_outcomes.text: Provide adequate training about the instrumentation for measuring and visualization of electrical quantities.
Provide the students with the essential techniques of circuit analysis to be succed in the following curricular units that depend on it.

syllabus_topics: Notion of electric charge, current, Voltage, and Power
Association of sources and resistances in series and parallel
Association in series and in parallel of coils and capacitors
Half wave and full wave rectification
Constitution and operation of bipolar transistors
teaching_methods: Theoretical and practice classes with the issues exposition and presentation of examples to consolidate the contents
Practical classes with laboratory assembly and simulation of circuits
bibliography: Jaime Batista dos Santos (2016)- ANÁLISE DE CIRCUITOS ELÉTRICOS, Publindústria, Porto, 2016
James Nilsson and Susan A. Riedel, "ELECTRIC CIRCUITS"
Microelectronic Circuits - 7th. Edition, Adel S. Sedra, Kenneth C. Smith, Oxford University Press.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
